* '''Original''' (this page): the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet prints only a game-text slip for the Decipher card ••Floating Refinery, so the card keeps that title, two-dot uniqueness and lore<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 16, 2011"; PDF dated 19 December 2011, the same file the Players Committee site offered in February 2012), page 2, slip 4 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a cloud sector (limit one per sector). Your Force generation is +1 at cloud sectors you occupy. Once during your control phase, if you occupy this sector, may draw destiny. If destiny > 2, retrieve 1 Force. If lost from table, place this device in Used Pile.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p2-132-Tibanna_Floating_Refinery.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list (in every capture from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013, as “Floating Refinery (V)”) showed the same text, with “Device” capitalized<ref name="cl-1274_4-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tibanna Floating Refinery]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints a full slip titled •Tibanna Floating Refinery (unique), with the same lore, the deployment limit removed and “and a battleground site” added<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=21, page 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=21 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a cloud sector. Your Force generation is +1 at cloud sectors you occupy. Once during your control phase, if you occupy this sector and a battleground site, may draw destiny. If destiny > 2, retrieve 1 Force. If lost from table, place this device in Used Pile.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1274-4-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-tibannafloatingrefinery-pre.gif]]) print it. The Players Committee announced this errata, with the new title, in the news post “Changes to Floating Refinery (v)” of 30 October 2012, effective immediately (“We have changed the title of the card to make it unique, but to also allow the use of non-virtual floating refinery”)<ref name="pc-news-floatingrefinery">Players Committee news post “Changes to Floating Refinery (v)”, by Stephen Kim, 30 October 2012 (“Effective Immediately”), on the News page as captured 29 November 2012: [https://web.archive.org/web/20121129130310/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=category&layout=blog&id=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>, and posted it again on its rules forum on 2 November 2012 as “an errata to Floating Refinery (V) … Note the name change”<ref name="pcforum-p764699">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 2 November 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p764699 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>. The new title and text both date from 30 October 2012 (both posts print “this Device” with a capital D).
